8a5e9ffb4 Plug memory leak.
b69ffd347 sudoers_policy_main: plug memory leak of iolog_path on error.
62dd5734a Plug a memory leak of list_cmnd in the fuzzers.

a0d9963fe journal_fdopen: free journal_path and close journal before setting Fixes a potential resource leak that currently cannot happen. Quiets a warning from Infer.
9c694e9a6 copy_vector: plug memory leak in error path Only the array was being freed, not the contents. GitHub issue #202.
ad220d72d Merge pull request #200 from BornThisWay/fix_mem_leak_converse
f5cae905c Fix memory leak of pass in converse().
5683fc6f7 The name of the C locale w/ UTF-8 support is not always C.UTF-8. Use a pattern to find it (if present) and use that value instead of hard-coding C.UTF-8.  This works around a leak sanitizer crash on certain inputs.
d7b2ff321 Add a simple regression test for logsrvd.conf parser. Unlike the parser fuzzer, this includes sample certs and keys. This test would have detected the BIO_new_file() bug in set_dhparams().
51b64780c Plug a memory leak.
339746730 ptrace_intercept_execve: plug memory leak of get_execve_info() buffer
d7ddff2a3 Add a hook for sudoers parse errors (including defaults and aliases). The hook can be used to log parser errors (sudoers module) or keep track of which files have an error (visudo). Previously, we only kept track of a single parse error.
31ab2e229 Plug a few test memory leaks now that they return from main().
590c4cf62 fuzz_logsrvd_conf: add stub version of sudo_regex_compile_v1(). We want to fuzz our parser, not the libc regular expression code.

f793042be command_allowed: plug memory leak on strdup() failure. Coverity CID 249972

f01b04401 log_server_alert: plug potential memory leak Coverity CID 249328
3c1ce4bf7 store_iobuf_local: fix potential double free on the error path.
c5027c796 Free potential leaks of passprompt_regex_handle. Coverity CID 249057
10ad934b7 Don't escape double quotes (") in a command when printing it. Previously, cvtsudoers and "sudo -l" would escape double quotes in a command or command line argument, which is not valid sudoers syntax.
546d4f624 Plug memory leak when making a default host-specific. We don't need to allocate new space for the binding list, just the members of the list.
e64a089ae Add reference counting to Defaults bindings. Previously, we checked that the previous entry's binding pointer was not the same while freeing.  However, to be able to merge Defaults records we cannot rely on Defaults entries with the same binding being immediately adjacent.  This removes the prev_binding checks in favor of a reference count which allows us to plug the memory leak in cvtsudoers when merging Defaults.
730ebabdb init_parse_tree() now takes ownership of lhost and shost, if any. This means that lhost and shost in struct sudoers_parse_tree are no longer const and that free_parse_tree() will free lhost/shost. The only consumer that passed in lho.st/shost was the SSSD back-end which has been updated to avoid a double-free.
a808f8e7e Fix setting _PATH_ASAN_LIB, need to double up the square brackets.
430048d16 cvtsudoers: initial support for CSV output For CSV output we double quotes strings that contain commas.  For each literal double quote character present inside the string, two double quotes are output.
850804472 Enable address and undefined behavior sanitizers in CI builds. We need to disable leak sanitizer during "make check" because it uses ptrace which is not allowed for unprivileged containers.
86df86ed9 Fix memory leak on error path if snprintf() overflows. Coverity CID 188804
b6561831b Re-enable error output for the sudoers parser. It is only the alias and defaults warnings we need to suppress.
cb187e0ac Only store the first log id received from the server. Plugs a small memory leak in intercept mode if the log server sends the log ID again for sub-commands.
0eb677b74 Only store the first log id received from the server. Plugs a small memory leak in intercept mode if the log server sends the log ID again for sub-commands.
4e0b77be4 tls_init.c: use SSL_CTX_set0_tmp_dh_pkey if present. Fixes a warning on OpenSSL 3.0 and plugs a memory leak of dhparams on config reload.
33d1b26c6 intercept_check_policy: Fix double free introduced in last commit If the command is not accepted we don't rebuild command_info[] and must not free it.  It will be freed by the policy instead.
6d3cf0ffd store_alert_local: fix memory leak on error path Coverity CID 238642
e2abcd6cb log_server_accept: fix memory leak of evlog when logging a sub-command. Coverity CID 238643
340d75394 Fix memory leak when client requests secret. Move closure allocation closer to where it is used.
9798fd86b Add garbage collection to resolve_editor(). Fixes a leak when evaluating the policy multiple times if sudoedit is set.
462e8ab47 Avoid some double frees in the fuzzer Now that sudoers free old values of NewArgv and command_info the fuzzer needs to reset those values.  Otherwise we end up with stashed values that have already been garbage collected.
3a090dcdc Plug some memory leaks when sudoers_policy_main is called multiple times. These would get cleaned up a policy close time but we don't want to bloat sudo's memory footprint when running a shell with multiple commands.
8b009f62e Plug memory leak in error path when sudoers cannot be opened.
2ea773ed1 Plug a memory leak in check_net_ifs found by address sanitizer.
cc647c32e Fix group list ref leak in sudoers_policy_store_result() on error path.
9b33594a4 Remove shell-style quotes in configure warning/error/notice messages. Square bracket quotes are used, no need for shell-style double quotes.
8a6589343 Add a suppression file for the libpython leaks. This is a big hammer but it seems like the best we can do for now. Allows "make check" to succeed when address sanitizer is used.
4e9baba2b Set logsrvd_config to NULL in logsrvd_conf_cleanup() after freeing it. Fixes a double free in fuzz_logsrvd_conf (but not sudo_logsrvd itself). Also fix linking fuzz_logsrvd_conf with OpenSSL.
52c29aa7a Plug memory leak on overflow; Coverity CID 220556
2759920b8 Document double escaping of backslashes.  Bug #961.
9bbf120bd For regess/fuzz set LC_ALL to C.UTF-8 if possible, falling back on C. Works around a crash in leak sanitizer when the locale is set to C and TLS support is enabled.
4a28b5d58 In find_path() stub only make a copy in outfile if returning FOUND. Fixed a recently-introduced memory leak in the fuzzer.
e0761b9e3 Also free safe_cmnd so it doesn't leak.
e5c1778e7 When logging JSON to syslog, wrap the contents in a "sudo" object. This makes it easier for log parsers to identify what is a sudo log entry.
d23508334 Add simple fuzzer for sudo_logsrvd.conf parser.
25f50e2f0 Add simple fuzzer for sudo.conf parser.
d1969b4f0 Plug memory leak if there are duplicate user_info or command_info entries.
ed7962769 Plug memory leak if there are duplicate user_info entries.
04de04f54 The lexer now sets an error string before returning ERROR. The parser will use that when reporting on an ERROR state.  This prevents the lexer from reporting errors about tokens that are not actually consumed by the parser and we don't have to worry about both the lexer and the parser reporting errors.  It also means we only get one error per sudoers line.
665f8d2e3 Only strip double quotes from an include path if len >= 2. Found locally using libfuzzer/oss-fuzz.
b4cabdb39 Don't free the alias name in alias_add() if the alias already exists. We need to be able to display it using alias_error(). Only free what we actually allocated in alias_add() on error and let the caller handle cleanup.  Note that we cannot completely fill in the alias until it is inserted.  Otherwise, we will have modified the file and members parameters even if there was an error. As a result, we have to remove those from the leak list after alias_add(), not before.
077c9b0c7 sudoersrestart() does not reset state to INITIAL, do it in init_lexer(). Fixes spurious errors from fuzz_sudoers, which calls the parser multiple times.
63a63680b Push lexer leak tracking down into check_fill.c. This lets us track things correctly when buffers are realloc()d. Rewrote fill() and append() to be more readable.
3237a18ee Use sudoersrestart() in fuzz_sudoers.c Since we run the parser multiple times we need to restart it each time.
bde441186 The --disable-leaks option is not recommended for production use.
bd4e8bc69 Remove options from the leak list before freeing them. Should fix oss-fuzz issue #30236
bdb02b1ef Got back to calling alias_free() on alias_add() failure. We now need to remove the name and members from the leak list *before* calling alias_add() since alias_add() will consume them for both success and failure.
71997da16 Fix potential leak of evlog->runuser. Also warn if we find an unexpected JSON type.
